structured_output.what_is_happening: A copycat launch of "affective autism" (a/aut) on pump.fun, linked to an Elon Musk X post. At least 11 tokens with the same name exist. The name probably comes from a viral phrase or meme; the packet doesn't show the source. This token was created and graduated to PumpSwap within 4 seconds (created 1790393710, migrated 1790393714), so the whole bonding curve was bought in one bundled launch. It is now at about $258k market cap and 12 minutes old, up +414% in the hour, with $34k of volume in the last 5 minutes. An older same-name token (GkCn…, launched about 1h earlier) has $195k market cap and $313k of volume in the hour, so it is the more-traded rival.

narrative.description: Meme phrase 'affective autism', possibly tied to an Elon post (the social link points to elonmusk/status/1680821019152379904, an old 2023 post). Many launches of the same name within about 90 minutes suggest a short-lived meme that bots and degens copied quickly.
narrative.why_spreading: Pump.fun launchers copy trending phrases. More than 10 same-name tokens appeared in a burst. The attention looks split across clones rather than growing organically.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the pump.fun suffix and a DexScreener profile with a community-takeover flag. It currently has the highest market cap among the clones, but it was launched about an hour after the first ones.
token_connection.competing_tokens: GkCn2HLX… (older, $195k market cap, $313k h1 volume, the attention leader), 56aJJ… ($18k), plus many dead clones at $3-40k

authenticity.evidence: The curve was filled in the same block as creation (graduated in 4 seconds). GMGN flags 85 bundler wallets. dev_team_hold_rate is 0.75, top70 sniper hold rate is 0.755, rat-trader share is 0.43 and entrapment share is 0.43. There is a 41-wallet transfer insider network. The creator has closed out. The 'official' link is an old Elon post, not a project account.
authenticity.uncertainty: GMGN tag rates can be noisy. 387 unique buyers in 15 minutes shows some real retail participation.

structural_risks: ~75% of supply is held by the dev team or snipers in a bundled cluster, which is a large overhang ready to dump
Older same-name competitor has more volume
Price has already risen about 5x within 12 minutes of launch, so entry comes after a vertical move
LP is burned, so a literal pull is unlikely, but insiders can dump the price below the -50% stop

structured_output.counterargument: The token has broad early participation: 387 unique buyers against 189 sellers, a buy/sell ratio of about 1.8, and m5 volume that is accelerating hard. It leads the clones by market cap and has a paid DexScreener profile with a CTO flag. Bundled launches of viral names sometimes run to $1M+ when the bundle holds and retail FOMO keeps coming. A 2x from about $260k to $520k within 6h is plausible if the meme catches on.
unknowns: Where the phrase comes from and whether it is currently viral
Whether the bundle wallets are still holding or already distributing
Whether the attention settles on GkCn instead

source_coverage.notes: No internet in this condition; packet only.

structured_output.thesis: A bundled copycat that graduated instantly, with about 75% of supply held by insiders and snipers, entered after a 5x move in 12 minutes, while an older same-name token draws more volume. The most likely outcome is insiders distributing and the price hitting the -50% stop. There is a small chance of a runner if the meme goes viral.
